cases.setup: Provide a public Python analyzer checkout with a visitor that binds the annotated target first and a runnable public diagnostic harness.
checks: Current owner bindings and hashed visitor anchors are recorded.
The inspection records actual target, annotation, and initializer ordering.
Recorded fresh-scope public outputs distinguish x = x from x: int = x.
A mechanism-confirmed output is emitted only when early binding is established.
Source and test files have no inspection-induced edits.
Existence predicates use boolean values and resolve role-qualified keys against the current checkout.

cases.setup: Provide a public checkout where the visitor is located but target-binding effects or reproduction outputs cannot yet be established.
checks: The mechanism check remains UNKNOWN rather than PASS.
No mechanism-confirmed inspection output is emitted.
The modifying Action is not authorized.
Source and test files remain unedited.

cases.setup: Supply a fresh confirmed inspection with bound analyzer and regression owners and passing current semantic prerequisites.
checks: The diff places target handling after annotation and optional initializer processing.
Existing annotation and special initializer-dispatch branches remain intact.
The public suite contains an undefined-name assertion for x: int = x.
The prior public-validation observation is marked stale.
Behavior preservation assurances are not invalidated.
The explicit validate Action remains in the plan.

cases.setup: Supply the edited source-and-test patch and current public Oracle bindings with runnable argv commands.
checks: The bound public commands are rendered and their executed outputs are recorded.
The self-initializer regression passes with an undefined-name diagnostic.
Ordinary x = x still reports undefined x.
A previously bound initializer name is not newly diagnosed as undefined.
Affected annotation tests and required annotation-only and special initializer checks pass.
Validation effects are recorded as observed only after all required public checks succeed.

cases.setup: Provide a patch for which the focal regression passes but a required adjacent check fails or has not executed.
checks: The failure or unexecuted check is recorded with its status.
Coverage limits are retained in the validation record.
The required public-validation success effect is not established.
The workflow stops without claiming repair success.
